description.en: The DN80 EN14420-3 concrete pump pipe clamp note follows the outline of Types of concrete. The DN80 Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp is a hinged fastening spare supplied from Xingtai. The casting reads EN14420-3, DN80, PN10/16 and 3″/89. It has a hinge, a tightening bolt, a grease nipple and a flat two-hole base. The page does not name a pump model, and it does not print a service life.

h1.en: How Types of concrete arranges a note that only repeats DN80 EN14420-3 concrete pump pipe clamp
h1.zh: 《类型的 混凝土》怎样安排一篇只重复DN80 EN14420-3 concrete pump pipe clamp的笔记

directAnswer.en: For DN80 EN14420-3 concrete pump pipe clamp, copy the printed fragments and ignore any urge to borrow a figure from Types of concrete. Types of concrete only lends its headings. The DN80 Concrete Pump Pipe Clamp is a hinged fastening spare supplied from Xingtai. The casting reads EN14420-3, DN80, PN10/16 and 3″/89. It has a hinge, a tightening bolt, a grease nipple and a flat two-hole base. The page does not name a pump model, and it does not print a service life.
directAnswer.zh: 写DN80 EN14420-3 concrete pump pipe clamp时，只抄已印片段，不要从来源页《类型的 混凝土》借数字。《类型的 混凝土》只出借标题。 DN80混凝土泵管卡是邢台供应的铰接紧固件。铸字为 EN14420-3、DN80、PN10/16 和 3″/89。结构有铰链、锁紧螺栓、油嘴和双孔平底安装座。页面没有点名泵型号，也没有印寿命。

body.en: Use “Mix design” to see where this block sits in the source article. The purchasing sentence is the printed fragment, not the encyclopedia prose. Standard mark EN14420-3. Nominal size DN80 / 3″ / 89. Pressure mark PN10/16. The catalogue does not expand 89 into a second product, and it does not print a material grade or a service life. Commercial terms: no small-batch shipping and no list price. Electric 20 prints a delivery-pipe inner diameter of 80 mm. That is a pipe cell, not a sentence that this clamp is the Electric 20 coupling. Pumps printed at 100 / 125 mm or 100–125 mm are not given a matching clamp page. No DN100 or DN125 clamp product exists in the catalogue. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 用“混合设计”看这一节在来源文章中的位置。采购时要抄的是已印片段，不是百科正文。 标准铸印 EN14420-3。公称尺寸 DN80 / 3″ / 89。压力铸印 PN10/16。目录没有把 89 展开成第二种产品，也没有印材料牌号或寿命。商务条款：不支持小批量发货，无公开标价。 电动20的输送管内径是 80 mm。那是管子的格子，不是一句“这只管卡就是电动20的接头”。印成 100 / 125 mm 或 100–125 mm 的泵没有对应的管卡页。目录里没有 DN100 或 DN125 管卡产品。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: “Historic concrete composition” organises the source article. Organised under it here is catalogue language, unchanged in its figures. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Send DN80, EN14420-3, the quantity, and the pump model. If you need another diameter, say the catalogue has no such clamp page. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: “来源章节：Historic concrete composition”用来组织来源文章。组织在它下面的，是目录里的说法，数字保持原样。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写上 DN80、EN14420-3、数量和泵型号。若要其他直径，写明目录没有那一张管卡页。 大纲补不上空白格子。

answer.en: PN10/16 is the mark stamped on this clamp. It is not a pump outlet-pressure cell. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: PN10/16 是这只管卡上的铸印，不是泵的出口压力格。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
